question: A cash payment that will settle a bill for 625 pairs of boots at ₹94 per pair of boots with successive discounts of 20% and 7% with a further discount of 20% on cash payment is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive multipliers = 0.80 × 0.93 × 0.80

Net factor = 0.5952

Total marked amount = 625 × 94 = 58750

Final payment = 58750 × 0.5952 = 34956

**∴ Answer = ₹34956**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Price per pair = 94, Quantity = 625; Discounts = 20%, 7%, 20%

**Formula used:**

Final price = Marked price × (1 − d₁) × (1 − d₂) × (1 − d₃)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total price = 625 × 94 = 58750

⇒ After 20% discount: 58750 × 0.80 = 47000

⇒ After 7% discount: 47000 × 0.93 = 43710

⇒ After 20% discount: 43710 × 0.80 = 34968

**∴ The correct answer is ₹34968.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discounts

Multiply remaining percentages: (1 − d/100)

Net Multiplier

Overall factor = product of all discount factors

Bulk Calculation

Compute total price first, then apply discounts

Common Mistake

Do not add discounts directly; apply successively
